Research agenda

See. Model. Act.

My research connects geometric perception, efficient predictive representations, and embodied action. Complex industrial environments provide a demanding real-world testbed for this agenda.

01

See

Panoramic and 3D Perception

Build geometrically consistent representations from panoramic, multi-view, and spatial observations.

02

Model

Efficient World Models

Predict future states and support planning while keeping inference cost under control.

03

Act

Embodied Intelligence and VLA

Ground vision, language, and action in spatial understanding for capable embodied agents.

Featured research

All projects →
Embodied IntelligenceResearch in progress

CARVE-VLA

A vision-language-action research direction centered on spatially grounded perception, reasoning, and action for embodied agents.

Panoramic GeometryResearch in progress

One Sphere, Many Charts

Group-Consistent Panoramic Depth from Frozen Foundation Models

Panoramic depth estimation that adapts frozen foundation models to spherical geometry through chart-based representations and group consistency.

Efficient IntelligenceExploratory research direction

Lightweight World Models

A first-principles exploration of world-model design that retains planning capability while reducing the cost of inference.

Applied research

Spatial intelligence in complex environments

My earlier work uses underground mines, longwall faces, and digital-twin systems as real-world settings for robust perception, panoramic video fusion, 3D reconstruction, and efficient visual computing.
